decisions: StateRootError and InvalidAppNameError carry public exitCode/code/remediation fields instead of importing src/cli/errors.ts, which PRE-1.3 owns; the top-level mapper must honor the numeric exitCode property.
appDir enforces the REG-FR-02 name pattern as a path-traversal defense even though name derivation lands later in src/config/name.ts.
Empty EASY_HOST_HOME/XDG_DATA_HOME values are treated as unset; relative environment paths resolve against the process CWD.
Writability is verified on the nearest existing ancestor before any mkdir, with EACCES/EPERM/EROFS/EEXIST/ENOTDIR/ENOSPC converted to StateRootError; existing directories are never chmodded.

payload.taskDescription: Implement the Paths module. Resolve the root from EASY_HOST_HOME, then XDG_DATA_HOME/easy-host, then ~/.local/share/easy-host. Provide typed accessors for appsDir, appDir(name), toolsDir, and buildkitDir, and an ensureLayout() that creates the tree with mode 0700. Reject a root that is not writable by the current user with exit-code class 2. Unit tests cover all three resolution orders, tilde expansion, mode bits on a temporary directory, and the unwritable-root failure.
